De Burlo Group Holds Stake in Apple (AAPL); Pdt Partners Decreased Its Holding in Mgic Invt Wis (MTG) as Market Value Declined
April 30, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
De Burlo Group Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. De Burlo Group Inc bought 6,447 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 140,138 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $23.72 million, up from 133,691 at the end of the previous reported quarter. De Burlo Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $839.34B market cap company. The stock increased 1.91% or $3.1 during the last trading session, reaching $165.42. About 34.42 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Peter Muller decreased its stake in Mgic Invt Corp Wis (MTG) by 37.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
